verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair axis for a payment processor, but the evidence pack documents no retention settings, retention periods, or shopper-data deletion capability. The closest items are adjacent features: removing products from the Product Feed (catalog sync to AI platforms) and expiring payment links. Neither gives the user control over how long Adyen keeps data or lets them delete it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
